en.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits with the weapon within 3 seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to apply <arc/>Jolt.

Being <arc/>Amplified decreases the number of Hits required.

Hits needed to activate normally | while <arc/>Amplified:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: #e${18-#d} | <arc/>13
• Machine Guns: #e${16-#c} | <arc/>11
• Auto Rifles: #e${15-#d} | <arc/>11
• Pulse Rifles: #e${14-#d} | <arc/>9
• Sidearms: #e${10-#d} | <arc/>7
• Rocket Pulse Rifle: #e${8-#d} | <arc/>5
• Scout Rifles, Hand Cannons: #e${7-#c} | <arc/>#e${6-#b}
• Swords: #e${6-#c} | <arc/>#e${4-#d}
• Glaives, Linear Fusion Rifles: #e${4-#d} | <arc/>3 
• Rocket Sidearm, Sniper Rifle?: #e${4-#d} | <arc/>2
• Bows, Grenade Launchers: #e${3-#d} | <arc/>2
• Shotguns, Aggressive Frame Fusion Rifle: #e${3-#d}|1<<arc/>

enhanced (
var b = 3
var c = 2
var d = 1
#e Number of Hits required while not <arc/>Amplified is decreased by 1.
)
